responsibility: Acts as the master machine-description file for the rs6000 backend. It defines the architectural register numbering, backend-wide UNSPEC and UNSPECV codes, instruction attributes such as type/size/dot/update/indexed/cpu, and many core RTL patterns for scalar, floating-point, control-flow, float128, and target-specific operations, while also including the specialized subsidiary .md files for synchronization, vector, VSX, Altivec, SPE, decimal FP, paired-single, crypto, and HTM support.
same_name_distinction: This is the master rs6000 machine-description file, defining core RTL attributes, UNSPEC values, register numbering, and including specialized .md files such as altivec.md, spe.md, and paired.md. Unlike powerpcspe.c, it is declarative RTL description rather than C implementation; unlike powerpcspe.h, it is not the macro header; unlike powerpcspe.opt, it is not the option table.
